name: What should I look for in a contractor's quality control plan?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor's quality control plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: When evaluating a contractor's quality control plan, look for details on their inspection procedures, material testing protocols, and how they address non-conformances. A robust plan should also outline team responsibilities, communication strategies, and adherence to local building codes. It's a decision factor to choose a contractor whose plan demonstrates proactive measures rather than just reactive fixes. Hometelligent Inc.'s plans emphasize transparency and client involvement, ensuring you understand how quality is maintained throughout your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor's quality control plan to detail inspection procedures, material testing, non-conformance handling, and adherence to codes.
